buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C The Additional Director General, GSI, SR, Hyderabad . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of The Additional Director General, GSI, SR, Hyderabad A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file.

6. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms and Conditions 1. The Bidders participating in the Bid should have an Office in Hyderabad, T elangana. The Proof of Address (i.e. copy of the MSME Registration / GST Registration Certificate in the name of the bidder / firm / proprietor) should be s ubmitted in the Bid documents. If necessary, the GSI committee may visit the l ocation for verification. 2. Bidder should have experience in executing similar contracts in any Governm ent Departments. With the relevant scope of AMC/Maintenance of IT equipment / LAN / Passive Com ponents and the Copy of the Certificate is to be submitted. 3. The Bidder Should sign/stamp on the SOW (Scope of Work) sheet of the GeM Bid document and upload the same along with their technical bid documents fo r consideration of their bid technically. 4. Bidder should submit the copies of “Satisfactory Completion of Service Certificate” from the Certifying Authority along with copies of the Work Order. Submission of only Work Orders will not be Considered. 5. The service provider shall deploy two (02) full-time Resident Service Engineer s at GSI, Southern Region, Hyderabad. The deployed engineers shall possess: Ø B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, Information Technology, Ele ctronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent. Ø Minimum two years' experience in LAN administration, structured cabling a nd network troubleshooting. The engineers shall be available five days a week, excluding Gazetted Holidays, and shall work as per office timings or as directed by the Officer-in-Charge. The y shall provide end-user support, attend complaints, undertake preventive main tenance, maintain service registers and assist during departmental programme s, video conferences and emergencies. Should able to converse in English, Hindi and Telugu Languages. 6. The Service Engineer deputed should be available on all days from 9.30 AM to 6.00 PM excluding Saturdays & Sundays, and will report to the Director, Geodata Division, GSI, SR, Hyderabad. 7. The service provider should deploy an equally qualified replacement Resident Service Engineer within 48 hours in the event of absence, leave, resignation or withdrawal of the deployed engineer.

8. The Bidder / Contractor / Service Provider have to make the Wages / Salaries to the Resident Engineers mentioned in the Scope of Work as per the Minimum Wages Act for Skilled Category Personnel as prescribed by “The Chief Labour Commissioner (C), Ministry of Labour & Employment”, from time to time. 9. The Bidder / Contractor / Service Provider has to quote the rates as per the Min imum Wages Act for Skilled Category Personnel as prescribed by “The Chief La bour Commissioner (C), Ministry of Labour & Employment”, from time to t ime. The EPF would be applicable @ 13% on an amount of Rs. 25,000/- and ESIC would be applicable @ 3.25% on an amount of Rs. 21,000/-. Also the Service Charges to Bidder / Contractor will be a minimum of @ 3.85% (i ncluding GST) on the wages paid (i.e. Basic Wages (VDA) + EPF + ESIC + GST) as per the prevailing GeM Terms & Conditions. 10. The service provider should mandatory maintain the attendance records, co mplaint register, preventive maintenance register and other service records to f acilitate effective monitoring of contract performance and report to the Director / Officer-in-Charge or any other Nominated Officer of Geodata Division, GSI, SR, Hyderabad. 11. The penalty shall be applicable as mentioned in the Scope of Work for non-d eployment / absence of the Resident Service Engineer(s), including failure to pr ovide a suitable replacement within the stipulated time. 12. The Bidders participating in the Bid should have an Office in Hyderabad, Telangana for easy accessibility while attending any Repair and also for arrang ing an alternate engineer if the service engineer deputed is on leave, as an im mediate replacement. 13. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) : EMD of Rs. 45,800/- (Rupees Forty Fi ve Thousand Eight Hundred Only) has to be submitted in the form of FDR or Bank Guarantee or Insurance Surety Bonds in favor of The Additional Director G eneral, GSI, SR, Hyderabad and should reach this office within One Week from t he date of Opening of the Bid, failing which the Bid will be liable for rejection. Bi dders availing EMD Exemption has to be submit relevant documents in claim of their exemption as per Rule 170 (i) of GFR 2017. 14. Performance Security : Successful bidder has to submit Performance Sec urity @ 5% of the Contract Value in the Form of FDR or Bank Guarantee or Insur ance Surety Bonds in favor of The Additional Director General, GSI, SR, Hyderab ad, valid for a period of 26 Months from the date of Acceptance of the AMC Cont ract. 15. Payment Terms : The Payment shall be made on Quarterly Basis after obt aining satisfactory certification after completion of the Period from the Director

/ Officer-in-Charge or any other Nominated Officer of Geodata Division, GSI, SR, Hyderabad. 16. Non compliance of any of the terms and conditions will be liable for rejection of the Bid. Note : GSI, SR, Hyderabad reserves its right to accept or reject any bid at a ny time, and also reserves its right to initiate appropriate legal action / pen alty as deemed fit against the bidders if they fail to comply with the terms and conditions of the Bid / Contract if awarded. .
